bio.title: About Brahm the Raccoon
bio.body: Brahm is the soft inner self — the raccoon who's been hurt, who still wants to be held, who's learning it's okay to receive. The music is warm acoustic guitar, close-mic vocals, lo-fi honesty. No drums, no production — just a person with a guitar and things they finally learned how to say.

tracks.title: Still Room
tracks.style: Male vocal, warm, intimate like Joji. Acoustic guitar, Diego Lorenzini style strumming, lo-fi warmth. Sparse, close-mic, natural room sound.

lyrics.verse1:
A single glass on the windowsill
Rain is running down, the room is still
My hands are open in my lap
I've been sitting here since the sun went black
lyrics.chorus:
My mind is racing
A thousand things I want to say
But none of them come out right
I don't know which words will hurt less
So I say nothing
And stay quiet instead
lyrics.verse2:
The screen is dark but still glowing
Blue light on my face, the room is silent
I open my mouth, close it again
Nothing comes out, nothing ever does
lyrics.bridge:
I just want to be held from behind
A hand on my chest, someone who's kind
And after that I could handle anything
(after that I could handle anything)
lyrics.outro:
I know what I want
I know what I need
I'm still here
On this windowsill
Waiting

tracks.title: What I Needed
tracks.style: Male vocal, warm, broken, intimate. Fingerpicked acoustic, lo-fi, devastating but soft. Close-mic, dry vocal, silent room.

lyrics.verse1:
Fever so high I couldn't think straight
Crying alone right next to the person
Who should have been holding me
But you just went away
lyrics.chorus:
I just needed you close
I just needed your arms around me
Is that too much to ask for
Am I asking for too much
lyrics.verse2:
The room spun slow like a carousel
I held myself and wondered
If I showed you how bad it really was
Would you finally sit beside me
lyrics.bridge:
Minimum
Just be near me
Hold me close
Give me your warmth
That's all I needed
lyrics.outro:
The door is still closed
I'm still on the bed
Still learning
Still learning
That needing someone shouldn't hurt this much

tracks.title: Warm
tracks.style: Male vocal, warm, soft, intimate. Gentle acoustic guitar, lo-fi warmth. A song that feels like being held by someone who won't leave.

lyrics.verse1:
I never knew what it felt like
To be held without needing to earn it
You just wrap your arms around me
And I don't have to be anything
lyrics.chorus:
You hold me close
You say I'm cute
You make me feel like I matter
Like I'm not too much
I didn't know someone could
Just be soft with me
No strings, no fixing
Just you and me
lyrics.verse2:
We tell each other the things we don't say
About the ones who hurt us before
And you listen without needing to fix it
You just stay close and warm
lyrics.bridge:
I'm learning that someone can hold me
Without needing a reason
Just because they like me near
Just because I'm me
lyrics.outro:
You hold me
And I'm okay
I'm okay
(I'm okay)

tracks.title: The Best at This
tracks.style: Male vocal, restless, almost too cheerful, intimate. Driving acoustic guitar, lo-fi, uptempo. The sound of someone who never stops moving.

lyrics.verse1:
Wake up and I'm already moving
Coffee's on, something's always brewing
Got a list, a plan, a reason
To keep these hands busy all season
lyrics.chorus:
If I'm busy then I'm good
If I'm useful then I should
Be allowed to take up space
In this room, in this place
lyrics.verse2:
I'll cook for you, I'll clean your space
I'll be there before you need to ask
I'm good at this, I'm the best at this
It's how I show love, it's how I exist
lyrics.break:
If I stopped doing all the things I do
Would I even know how to be with you
Would you still love me
Without my service

tracks.title: Counting Every One
tracks.mood: Longing, warm, a prayer of touch
tracks.style: Male vocal, warm, gentle, intimate. Fingerpicked acoustic, lo-fi warmth, suspended. Close-mic, delicate. A song that lists every touch you want.

lyrics.verse1:
Head pats when I'm feeling small
Your fingers tracing through it all
Warmth against my back at night
You don't even know you're holding me tight
lyrics.chorus:
These hands
I want them on me
These hands
I want them to know me
To hold me from behind
A kiss along my hairline
lyrics.verse2:
Fingers in my hair, tracing my ears
Nails on my back, the feeling I hold dear
My head in your hands, my nape in your grip
A bite on my neck, a bite on my lip
lyrics.bridge:
Acaríciame el pelo, las orejas
Toqué mi nuca, muerde mi cuello
I want to feel all of it
Every touch you give me
I keep them all
lyrics.outro:
Head pats when I'm feeling small
Your fingers in my hair
That's all I want

tracks.title: Same Language
tracks.style: Male vocal, relaxed, conversational, comfortable. Strummed acoustic guitar, lo-fi, easy. Natural, warm, unpolished. Like talking to someone who gets it.

lyrics.verse1:
We talk about everything and nothing
Games, music, life, the internet
It doesn't matter what we say
What matters is it's easy
lyrics.chorus:
We speak the same language
Comfortable, strange, ours
I don't have to translate
With you
I don't have to explain
lyrics.verse2:
In person it's easier than text
No performing, no guessing what comes next
We just exist together
And that's enough
lyrics.bridge:
We share a single brain cell
It's bouncing back and forth
Sometimes it's in your head
Sometimes it's in the north
Who cares. It works.
lyrics.outro:
Just two weirdos sitting
Weird together
Sending memes
(sending memes)
That's enough

tracks.title: Reading the Room
tracks.style: Male vocal, smooth, calm, controlled — the mask. Bright strummed acoustic, clean, too clean. Unsettlingly pleasant.

lyrics.verse1:
You ask me how I'm doing
I laugh and say I'm great
I've gotten so good at being fine
Even I believe it sometimes
lyrics.chorus:
I'm fine
Everything's fine
I smile so easy
You'd never know the difference
I'm fine
(I've been saying it so long it's true)
lyrics.verse2:
The list in my head gets longer
Things I wanted to say today
But the moment passed, the door is closed
And I'm already on to the next thing
lyrics.bridge:
I learned early that showing how you feel
Just makes things harder
So I stopped
And now I don't know how to start again
lyrics.outro:
The door is still closed
The list is still long
But I'm fine
(I'm fine)

tracks.title: Trying
tracks.style: Male vocal, warm, vulnerable, learning. Full strummed acoustic, lo-fi warmth. Intimate but present. Hopeful with an edge.

lyrics.verse1:
You reached for me first
I didn't know what to do with that
After years of giving
And getting nothing back
lyrics.chorus:
You wanted me
You wanted me back
I don't know how to receive it
But I'm trying
I'm trying
lyrics.verse2:
I've spent so long being the one who gives
I don't know what to do when someone gives to me
It's unfamiliar, it's uncomfortable
But I want to learn
lyrics.bridge:
I don't know how to stop
I don't know how to just receive
I feel like I'm only wanted
(only wanted)
When I've given everything

tracks.title: The Rope Loosens
tracks.style: Male vocal, warm, safe, present. Slow fingerpicked acoustic, lo-fi, letting each chord ring. Close-mic, warm. The voice of someone finally resting.

lyrics.verse1:
The rope goes around me
And something in my chest unties
For once my mind is quiet
For once the noise stops
lyrics.chorus:
I didn't know my body
Could feel this still
I didn't know my skin
Could feel this warm
lyrics.verse2:
You said you love me
You said you want me here
And I cried
Because someone finally meant it
lyrics.bridge:
Like finding a warm cave
In the middle of a storm
I rest here
You hold me here
I'm warm

tracks.title: Still Reaching
tracks.style: Male vocal, tired, grateful, resolved. Strummed acoustic, lo-fi warmth, bittersweet. Same guitar sound as track one but warmer now. The album comes full circle.

lyrics.verse1:
I've been hurt, I've been left
I've been crying on the bathroom floor
And I know love ends, I know people go
I've watched it happen before
lyrics.chorus:
So why do I still want
To be held again
Why do I still hope
When I know how it ends
lyrics.verse2:
The raccoon on the floor
Half bone, half rope, still warm
Nothing left to prove, nothing left to lose
But one paw still moves toward you
lyrics.bridge:
Because I've been warm
Because I've been seen
Because I've been held
And I can't forget that
The cave exists
I've been there
I've been warm
And I can't unlearn that
lyrics.outro:
Still reaching
(still here)
Still reaching
(still reaching)

bio.title: About
bio.content:
Brahm the Raccoon (also known as Lonely Raccoon) is a lo-fi acoustic music project from Paraguay. The project is the musical expression of Brahm — the soft, vulnerable inner self of someone who spent years behind masks and service, finally learning to ask for what he needs.

The debut album 'Still Reaching' (2026) is a 10-track cycle that moves from cold isolation through devastating wound, tentative warmth, compulsive busyness, sensual longing, genuine connection, the exhaustion of the mask, the terror of receiving, the safety of being held, and finally — the absurd, tired hope of still reaching.

Musically, it's sparse acoustic guitar, close-mic vocals, lo-fi warmth. No drums, no production tricks. Just a person with a guitar in a room, saying the things they were never able to say.

posts.title: How Still Reaching Came to Be
posts.excerpt: The story behind the album — from therapy sessions to voice notes to ten songs about reaching.
posts.content:
This album started in a psychology repository. Not a recording studio — a folder full of markdown files analyzing my own core wounds, defense mechanisms, and attachment patterns.

I realized I was using intellectualization to avoid feeling things, so I used an AI to intellectualize my feelings for me. But underneath all the analysis, there was a raccoon who just wanted to be held.

So I started writing. The first song came from sitting on a windowsill. The second from a fever. The third from being held for the first time without needing to earn it.

Ten songs later, 'Still Reaching' is the result. It's not polished. It's not produced. It's a person with a guitar and things they finally learned how to say.

The arc is simple: cold → wound → warmth → busy → longing → connection → mask → wanting → being held → still reaching.

If one of these songs makes you feel less alone, it worked.

posts.title: Why a Raccoon?
posts.excerpt: On the mascot, the metaphor, and why I chose the trash panda.
posts.content:
Raccoons are resilient little creatures. They get into trash, they get scared, they get hurt — and they keep coming back. They're scrappy. They survive.

Brahm is the raccoon part of me. The part that's been called annoying, that's been left alone in fevers, that's spent years being useful so people would stay. The part that's still, against all evidence, reaching out.

The album cover (in my head) is a raccoon on a floor — half bone, half rope, still warm. Nothing left to prove. Nothing left to lose. But one paw still moves toward you.

That's the whole project in one image.

sections.title: The People Who Held Space
items: To everyone who held me without needing a reason. You taught me that the cave exists.
To the person who said 'you wanted me back' and meant it.
To the one whose brain matched mine at the exact right time.
To the rope that held me together when I was coming apart.

sections.title: The Therapists & Guides
items: To the clinical framework that helped me understand the pattern.
To the AI that became an unlikely therapeutic mirror.
To every voice note transcript that became a lyric.

sections.title: The Tools
items: Suno V5_5 — for giving me a voice when I couldn't sing yet.
The therapy repo — for being the most honest thing I've ever written.
Acoustic guitar — for never needing to be anything else.

sections.title: You, the Listener
items: If you made it this far: thank you. You're not alone. The cave exists. You're allowed to stay.
